/// An audio asset from the file, returned by `Context.audio` and played with

/// ```as

///     source: AudioSource? = null;
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         this.source = context.audio("myAudio");
///         return true;
///     }
///
///     override pointerDown(event: PointerEvent): void {
///         let source = this.source;
///         if (source != null) {
///             Audio.play(source);
///         }
///         event.hit();
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export class AudioSource {

    get duration(): f64;

    /// The sample rate of the audio in Hz.
    get sampleRate(): u32;

    /// The number of audio channels.
    get channels(): u32;

    /// Releases the source now instead of when it is collected. Playing a
    /// released source returns null.
    release(): void;
}

/// One playback of an `AudioSource`, returned by the `Audio` play

/// ```as

/// if (sound != null) {

    pause(): void;

/// Plays `AudioSource` assets and reads the audio engine's clock.
///
/// Every play function returns the new `AudioSound`, or null when there is
/// no audio engine or the source was released.
/// ```as
/// let source = context.audio("myAudio");
/// if (source != null) {
///     // Start half a second from now.
///     let sound = Audio.playInTime(source, 0.5);
/// }
/// ```
export namespace Audio {
    /// Plays the source immediately.
    /// ```as
    /// let source = this.source;
    /// if (source != null) {
    ///     this.sound = Audio.play(source);
    /// }
    /// ```
    export function play(source: AudioSource): AudioSound?;

    /// Plays the source at an absolute engine time in seconds, for precise
    /// scheduling against `Audio.time`.
    /// ```as
    /// let source = this.source;
    /// if (source != null) {
    ///     this.sound = Audio.playAtTime(source, Audio.time() + 1);
    /// }
    /// ```
    export function playAtTime(source: AudioSource, seconds: f64): AudioSound?;

    /// Plays the source after a delay in seconds, relative to the current
    /// engine time.
    /// ```as
    /// let source = this.source;
    /// if (source != null) {
    ///     this.sound = Audio.playInTime(source, this.scheduleSeconds);
    /// }
    /// ```
    export function playInTime(source: AudioSource, seconds: f64): AudioSound?;

    /// Plays the source at an absolute engine time in PCM frames, for precise
    /// scheduling against `Audio.timeFrame`.
    /// ```as
    /// let source = this.source;
    /// if (source != null) {
    ///     let frame = Audio.timeFrame() + Audio.sampleRate();
    ///     this.sound = Audio.playAtFrame(source, frame);
    /// }
    /// ```
    export function playAtFrame(source: AudioSource, frame: f64): AudioSound?;

    /// Plays the source after a delay in PCM frames, relative to the current
    /// engine time. Convert from seconds with frames = seconds *
    /// `Audio.sampleRate()`.
    /// ```as
    /// let source = this.source;
    /// if (source != null) {
    ///     this.sound = Audio.playInFrame(source, this.scheduleFrames);
    /// }
    /// ```
    export function playInFrame(source: AudioSource, frame: f64): AudioSound?;

    /// Returns the absolute time of the audio engine in seconds, a clock
    /// independent of any sound.
    /// ```as
    /// override advance(seconds: f64): bool {
    ///     this.engineTime = Audio.time();
    ///     this.engineTimeFrame = Audio.timeFrame();
    ///     this.sampleRate = Audio.sampleRate();
    ///     return true;
    /// }
    /// ```
    export function time(): f64;

    /// Returns the absolute time of the audio engine in PCM frames.
    export function timeFrame(): f64;

    /// Returns the sample rate of the audio engine in Hz. Use it to convert
    /// seconds to frames: frames = seconds * sample rate.
    export function sampleRate(): f64;
}
